reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about electronic/steric effects of surface functional groups on Fe catalysts, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific relationship between functional group identity and catalytic performance in Fe-based systems under operando conditions.
premises: Surface functional groups on Fe catalysts create distinct electronic and steric effects
These electronic/steric effects influence reactant adsorption and activation
Systematic variation of surface functional groups can optimize catalytic performance
Metal-support interactions and surface reconstruction are additional governing factors
